analysis.one_line_summary: Clean studio product render of the pink WavyTalk thermal round brush wrapped in a pink satin ribbon with Black Friday 'UP TO 31% OFF' offer text.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional graphic for Black Friday featuring the pink WavyTalk heated blowout / thermal round brush. The product stands upright against an off-white/light grey minimalist studio background, artistically wrapped and framed by a spiraling light pink satin ribbon. On the left side, bold dark text displays the brand logo 'WAVYTALK', followed by 'UP TO 31% OFF' in large font and 'Black Friday' beneath it. The digital display on the handle of the brush shows '420°F' and an 'ION' indicator light.
